'''Anistia Qu''' was a citizen of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. Along with hundreds of others, Qu disappeared from Cularin in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], an occurrence attributed by some to the activity of the [[Thaereian military|Navy of Thaere]].
